responsibility: Implements token substitution for Rust macro_rules! transcription after a rule has matched. This file expands $metavar references into the original matched token ranges, validates and reproduces repetition patterns with optional separators, constructs per-iteration fragment maps for nested repetition expansion, detects misuse such as unresolved or differently repeated metavariables, and returns the substituted AST::Token stream that will be reparsed into an AST fragment by the macro expander.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file contains the working substitution algorithm for macro transcription: expanding $metavars from matched token ranges, validating repetition counts, building per-iteration submaps for repeated matches, and producing the substituted token stream. The header only declares the SubstituteCtx object and its substitution entry points.
